facts.aussage: V2 /ws/v2: accept -> ProtocolV2Connection(service,client_id,server_version,server_commit) -> sink via loop.call_soon_threadsafe in asyncio.Queue, separater writer()-Task. Vor accepted: wait_for(receive, timeout=handshake_timeout); danach paralleles Warten Receive vs transport_close. Dispatch handle_binary/handle_text. finally: close_session(), Close-Code-Aushandlung, Audit session.closed. KEIN manager.connect im V2-Pfad.
